newsitem.title: CANADA: CN to sell shortline to Quebec Railway.
newsitem.headline: CN to sell shortline to Quebec Railway.

text.p: Canadian National Railway Co said on Friday that it agreed to sell its 235-kilometre-long rail line between Matapedia and Chandler, Quebec to a subsidiary of Quebec Railway Corp.
The terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

The sale, scheduled to close December 1, to Chemin de fer Baie des Chaleurs, is part of CN's three-year system-wide rationalization program aimed at transferring secondary lines to shortline railways, CN said.

The Matapedia-Chandler line's main customers along the east coast of the Gaspe peninsula are the Gaspesia Pulp and Paper Co in Chandler, Stone-Consolidated Corp in New Richmond, and the Delebo sawmill in Nouvelle, CN said.
